§6Basic Metals§f

§aSmelt, compress, and gear up with your new metals!§f

Each of the §e9§f base metals comes as ingot, nugget, dust, gear, plate, coin, and storage block. Smelt ores 1:1, or double your yield through the §bPulverizer§f. Gears are §e4§f ingots + §e1§f Iron Rod; plates are §e2§f ingots.

The §bInduction Smelter§f is where things get interesting: ore + sand gives §e2§f ingots, ore + Rich Slag gives §e3§f, and ore + Cinnabar gives §e3§f plus a bonus Gold Ingot. Want it simpler? Toss Pyrotheum Dust + ore in a crafting grid for §e1§f ingot, or Petrotheum Dust + ore for §e2§f dust.

§ePS:§f Storage blocks work as beacon bases and prevent mob spawns.
